acceptance: Given a previous output listed with backslash relative paths and the separator `\`, the output-folder check accepts `reconciliation-report.md`, `additions\use-cases.csv` and `vendor\acme\questions.csv`, refuses a foreign file such as `vendor\acme\notes.md` or `..\x.csv`, and still refuses a name containing a backslash on a `/` platform, so the allowed pattern is not widened. (B09)

Given proposal folders `mr-1` and `mr-10` and a nested folder, the report's `Proposal:` lines use `/` in `/` order on every platform, and `posixPath("mr-1\\tracker-updates.csv", "\\")` gives `mr-1/tracker-updates.csv`. (B03)
Two runs with the same inputs give identical outputs, and the test snapshot and listing helpers key files with `/` on every platform. (B03)
